latest_release.body:
**Dify 1.20.0 keeps your traces flowing and your knowledge bases safer.** Export traces to any OpenTelemetry collector, keep Langfuse working after its legacy ingestion endpoint retirement, and scan uploaded knowledge files for malware before they are indexed. Chatflows can show Agent tool activity as it happens, and personal access tokens let scripts and agents call the Dify OpenAPI on your behalf. The bundled plugin daemon is upgraded to **0.6.15-local**.

[New Features](#user-content-new-features) · [Configuration and Integration Changes](#user-content-configuration-and-integration-changes) · [Database Migrations](#user-content-database-migrations) · [Upgrade Guide](#user-content-upgrade-guide)

## New Features

### New HITL: bring approvals into your team's messaging tools

**Integrate human review into your workflows via email and the messaging tools your team already uses.** New HITL introduces shared channels, centralized contacts, notification templates, and verified approval forms—allowing your team to configure recipients once and reuse them across Human Input nodes, and is now enabled by default (`NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_HITL_IM=true`). (#44864, #45945)

* **Reach approvers where they work.** Configure email and an IM platform—**Slack, Feishu/Lark, Microsoft Teams, DingTalk, or WeCom**—to deliver workflow review requests through your team's existing channels.
* **Manage recipients in Contacts.** Sync IM directories and select approvers from a shared contact list. Workflows can also address the initiator or use one-time and dynamic email recipients.
* **Approve in cards or forms.** Recipients can review requests directly in supported IM cards or open standalone forms, with Dify login or email verification to verify their identity.
* **Customize notifications with workflow context.** Use templates and workflow variables to include essential context in notification subjects and bodies.
* **Test and track delivery.** Send test notifications to verify your setup and inspect delivery records to troubleshoot requests that did not arrive as expected.
* **Adopt New HITL in existing workflows.** Use opt-in migration to upgrade legacy Human Input nodes when your workflow is ready.

Deployment requirements are listed under [Configuration and Integration Changes](#user-content-configuration-and-integration-changes).

### Export traces to any OpenTelemetry collector

Bring Dify execution traces into your existing observability stack. The new **OpenTelemetry provider** exports app and Agent traces to any compatible collector, allowing you to track workflow steps, model calls, and tool activity together in your preferred platform. Use these traces to inspect request execution and diagnose failures without requiring a vendor-specific Dify integration. (#45659)

**Langfuse tracing now supports Langfuse v4 and the current Langfuse Cloud ingestion service.** Existing Langfuse configurations continue to work. (#45606)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Langfuse Cloud retired its legacy ingestion endpoint on **November 16, 2026**, and self-hosted Langfuse v4 rejects events sent to it. Upgrade to 1.20.0 to keep delivering traces to those deployments.

### Scan knowledge uploads for malware

Protect your knowledge bases by scanning uploaded files for malware before they are extracted or indexed. When enabled (`FILE_SCAN_ENABLED=true`), workspace owners and admins can configure scanners once under **Integrations → File Security Scan**, then define how each knowledge base uses them. Supported scanners include **Cloudmersive, Scanii, OPSWAT MetaDefender Cloud**, and a **Custom Endpoint**. (#46090, #46492)

* **Choose protection per knowledge base.** Select a scanner and configure fallback behavior when scanning is unavailable or a file cannot be scanned.
* **Protect knowledge uploads across Dify.** Scanning covers classic knowledge bases, RAG Pipeline local-file sources, and Agent Knowledge Base uploads.

detail.readme:
![cover-v5-optimized](./images/GitHub_README_if.png)

Dify Cloud · Self-hosting · Documentation · Dify edition overview

Dify is an open-source LLM app development platform. Its intuitive interface combines AI workflow, RAG pipeline, agent capabilities, model management, observability features (including [Opik](https://www.comet.com/docs/opik/integrations/dify), [Langfuse](https://docs.langfuse.com), and [Arize Phoenix](https://docs.arize.com/phoenix)) and more, letting you quickly go from prototype to production. Here's a list of the core features: ## Quick start > Before installing Dify, make sure your machine meets the following minimum system requirements: > > - CPU >= 2 Core > - RAM >= 4 GiB
The easiest way to start the Dify server is through [Docker Compose](docker/docker-compose.yaml). Install [Docker](https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/) with a running daemon, Docker Compose v2.35.0 or later, and OpenSSL. For a new deployment, run the following commands from the repository root. For an existing deployment, preserve your `.env` and follow the [upgrade guidance](docker/README.md#review-configuration-after-an-upgrade). ```bash cd docker cp .env.example .env openssl rand -hex 32 ``` Open `.env` and set `DIFY_AGENT_LOCAL_SANDBOX_AUTH_TOKEN` to the generated value. Keep the default `COMPOSE_PROFILES` value for the bundled services. Service defaults load automatically; no additional configuration files are required. From the same `docker` directory, start the services: ```bash docker compose up -d docker compose ps --all ``` Once the services are running, open [http://localhost/install](http://localhost/install) to complete the initial setup. The one-time `init_permissions` service is expected to exit with code `0`. For optional settings and service overrides, see the [Docker deployment guide](docker/README.md#configure-dify). ### Seeking help Please refer to our [FAQ](https://docs.dify.ai/getting-started/install-self-hosted/faqs) if you encounter problems setting up Dify. Reach out to [the community and us](#community--contact) if you are still having issues. > If you'd like to contribute to Dify or do additional development, refer to our [guide to deploying from source code](https://docs.dify.ai/getting-started/install-self-hosted/local-source-code) ## Key features **1. Workflow**: Build and test powerful AI workflows on a visual canvas, leveraging all the following features and beyond. **2. Comprehensive model support**: Seamless integration with hundreds of proprietary / open-source LLMs from dozens of inference providers and self-hosted solutions, covering GPT, Mistral, Llama3, and any OpenAI API-compatible models. A full list of supported model providers can be found [here](https://docs.dify.ai/getting-started/readme/model-providers). ![providers-v5](https://github.com/langgenius/dify/assets/13230914/5a17bdbe-097a-4100-8363-40255b70f6e3) **3. Prompt IDE**: Intuitive interface for crafting prompts, comparing model performance, and adding additional features such as text-to-speech to a chat-based app. **4. RAG Pipeline**: Extensive RAG capabilities that cover everything from document ingestion to retrieval, with out-of-box support for text extraction from PDFs, PPTs, and other common document formats. **5. Agent**: Autonomous agents with a sandbox of their own: they run commands, install software, and handle files to get open-ended tasks done. Describe the agent you want and it builds itself. Give it skills, connect tools from [Dify Marketplace](https://marketplace.dify.ai/?category=tool), MCP servers, or your own APIs, and put it to work as a chat app or as a step in any workflow. **6. LLMOps**: Monitor and analyze application logs and performance over time. You could continuously improve prompts, datasets, and models based on production data and annotations. **7. Backend-as-a-Service**: All of Dify's offerings come with corresponding APIs, so you could effortlessly integrate Dify into your own business logic. ## Using Dify - **Cloud
** We host [Dify Cloud](https://cloud.dify.ai) so you can try Dify without managing a server. See the [pricing page](https://dify.ai/pricing) for current plans and usage allowances. If you run into issues, [contact our Cloud support team](mailto:cloud@dify.ai?subject=%5BGitHub%5DDify%20Cloud%20Support). - **Self-hosting Dify Community Edition
** Quickly get Dify running in your environment with this [starter guide](#quick-start). Use our [documentation](https://docs.dify.ai) for further references and more in-depth instructions. - **[Dify Enterprise](https://dify.ai/dify-enterprise)
** For organizations requiring self-hosting, SSO, RBAC Security and Enterprise Support SLAs, please fill out [this form](https://share-na2.hsforms.com/14-09ff5HS92Sh4m3f4yrcw40s9fk) to speak to a solution representative.
## Staying ahead Star Dify on GitHub and be instantly notified of new releases. ## Advanced Setup For custom configuration, observability, and deployment options, see [Advanced Setup](docs/ADVANCED_SETUP.md). ## Contributing Dify welcomes contributions of all kinds: - **Code**: Read the [Contribution Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md), then browse [good first issues](https://github.com/langgenius/dify/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22good%20first%20issue%22). - **Ideas and feedback**: Start or join a [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/langgenius/dify/discussions). - **Translations**: Follow the [internationalization guide](web/i18n/README.md) to add or update a locale. - **Community**: Share the apps you build, help other users, and spread the word about Dify. ### Contributors ## Community & contact Choose the channel that best fits your question: - [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/langgenius/dify/discussions): Get help, share feedback, and propose ideas. - [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/langgenius/dify/issues): Report reproducible bugs and track engineering work. Read the [Contribution Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening one. - [Discord](https://discord.gg/FngNHpbcY7): Chat in real time, share your apps, and connect with other Dify users. - [X](https://x.com/dify_ai): Follow Dify for release news and project updates. ## Star History [![Star History Chart](https://star-history.dera.page/svg?repos=langgenius/dify&type=date&legend=top-left)](https://star-history.dera.page/langgenius/dify?type=date&legend=top-left#gh-light-mode-only) [![Star History Chart](https://star-history.dera.page/svg?repos=langgenius/dify&type=date&theme=dark&legend=top-left)](https://star-history.dera.page/langgenius/dify?type=date&legend=top-left#gh-dark-mode-only) ## Security disclosure Report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub Security Advisories, following our [security policy](SECURITY.md). Do not disclose them in public issues, discussions, or pull requests. ## License This repository is licensed under the [Dify Open Source License](LICENSE), based on Apache 2.0 with additional conditions.
